description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwawala, Harispatthuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320320
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their locations, cadastral maps, ownership details, and land registration particulars - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
